name: PartnerServiceAdd React rewrite: Testovaci instalace (Test installation) tab
description:
## Why?

This is how a partner installs their addon on a test shop and issues an API token before submitting for approval. It has no form fields of its own but it is the entry point to the `PartnerServiceInstall` modal, so the modal wiring is the real work.

## What?

Port `sub/ServiceDetail/TestInstallation.tpl` to React as a read-only table plus action links, remove the external-tab bridge entry and delete the legacy partial. Wire the `PartnerServiceInstall` modal (test install and token creation) and the link into the `PartnerServiceEndpoints` modal.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Installation table renders the same columns, states and empty state as the legacy tab
- `PartnerServiceInstall` modal opens, creates a test installation and issues a token exactly as before; its controller is not modified beyond the Inertia bridge
- Link into the `PartnerServiceEndpoints` modal works
- Tab visibility gate unchanged (edit mode only)
- Every `data-testid` from `TestInstallation.tpl` preserved verbatim, no hardcoded strings
- `TestInstallation.tpl` deleted and its bridge entry removed
- `make check-fast`, `make lint`, `make fe-test` green

## Resources

- Legacy: `admin/controllers/templates/sub/ServiceDetail/TestInstallation.tpl:12,49,65`, `admin/controllers/PartnerServiceInstallController.php`
- `cms/packages/Connectors/Model/ApiPartner.php` (`getApiAccessTokens`), `cms/packages/Miscellaneous/Helper/Partners.php`
- Data: `st_api.token`, `st_api.service_endpoint_token`, `st_api.service_endpoint_group_token`
